regions.today: Cloudy to start with outbreaks of rain and drizzle through the morning. Scattered showers will develop later in the day with sunny spells.Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 or 21 degrees, warmest further south.Light to moderate southerly winds veering west to northwesterly.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be a mix of cloud and clear spells, but staying mostly dry apart. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees. Moderate west to northwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start off dry and cloudy, with a brighter start in the south. Light rain from the west will move in through the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees. Light to moderate west to southwest winds.
